description: integrations.sh is a registry of developer and agent integration surfaces across many services. It indexes APIs, GraphQL endpoints, MCP servers, and CLIs by domain and offers discovery tooling for those surfaces.
summary: integrations.sh exposes three documented developer surfaces on its own domain: a REST API at `https://integrations.sh/api`, a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://integrations.sh/mcp`, and an `integrations` CLI; no credential setup or concrete auth mechanics are documented on the pages found.
